Conclusion reached from evidence alone, before reading the injector's own log: aml-compliance.
confirmation_basis: Blind conclusion (aml-compliance) matches the injector's own ground-truth log exactly. Second independent replication of this fault type -- same clean evidentiary shape as the first case, no confounding retry symptom manifested either time.
